feature: Deck row pips and the row as a target

rows.label: /decks/[id] — a press beside the name opens the card

note: Steps are Playwright verbs. The deck takes PROBE_DECK from the environment, so no account's id is committed. `/collection` is visited as `?view=rows` because the desktop default is the grid, which draws no pips — the surface the defect was reported on has to be asked for by name. Each row scrolls to where the cards are: the deck page opens on its hero and its tabs, so a sheet shot at the top photographs no cost column at all. Selectors carry no `main` of their own: `contact-sheet.mjs` scopes every verb through `lib/surface.mjs`, and a second prefix would chain `main` inside `main` and match nothing.
